name: sec-form-d-funding-signals
title: SEC Form D Funding Tracker — Change Tracking + Signal Score
description: Daily list of US companies that just raised a private round, from official SEC Form D filings. Optional change tracking (new vs repeat issuers, D/A amount deltas under a stateKey) and an explainable 0–100 signal score. Caps only limit output — set Max results / Max filings to scan high enough (or use RUN_SUMMARY skip counts) if you want a full baseline. No login or proxy.
